title: Rework Source-Repair Days Schedule, Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Schedule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, rework source-repair days are added to the rework courtesy rental days on a covered network rework. The rework source-repair days follow the calendar days from the drop-off date to the ready date of the customer-pay repair the coverage was issued on, held under Customer-Pay Repairs; the drop-off date is the date that repair started.

| Calendar days from drop-off to ready on the source customer-pay repair | Rework source-repair days |
|---|---|
| the long-repair days, 15, or more | the long-repair extra days, 2 days |
| the medium-repair days, 8, or more, but fewer than 15 | the medium-repair extra days, 1 day |
| fewer than 8 | none |
| no customer-pay source repair | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Drop-off date | Ready date | Calendar days | Rework source-repair days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 8 March | 7 | none |
| 1 March | 9 March | 8 | 1 day |
| 1 March | 15 March | 14 | 1 day |
| 1 March | 16 March | 15 | 2 days |

## Notes

- The days are counted between the two dates recorded on the Customer-Pay Repairs order the coverage was issued on.
- A coverage issued on an insurance claim repair, a glass job or a calibration order has no customer-pay source repair, and no rework source-repair days.
- Where either date is missing on the source repair, the span counts as zero days.
